name: exp-card
author: BlaXun
description: Every monster kill has a chance to drop a tiered Exp Card, bound to the killer for the standard pickup window. Two families -- Base Exp Cards and Job Exp Cards -- each with ten levels; higher-level mobs drop higher-level cards. A level 10 card grants roughly 5% of the exp a level-98 character needs for the next level, and each lower level is about half the one above it. Streamlines offline levelling without touching per-mob drop tables.

settings.label: Drop chance (0.01% units)
settings.description: Odds a card drops from any given monster kill, in 0.01% units. 225 = 2.25% (the default), 100 = 1%, 1000 = 10%. At ~150 kills per hour and a 50/50 base/job split, 2.25% works out to ~5-9% of a level per hour on whichever axis the player is pushing -- noticeable without trivialising the grind. Which card (base or job, level 1-10) is decided per drop -- see the mod's README.
